chapter_note: Chapter is severely damaged (96.5% damage ratio) but the surviving content is uniformly cosmological-substrate teaching. The chapter narrates the Living Spirit's reception of the firstfruits of the Five Sons, the mingling/crucifixion of the archonic host, and the construction of the firmaments. A sustained craftsman/architect analogy (man-architect who builds for the king; craftsman shaping vessels in a crucible) functions as an internal cosmological simile, not as editorial application — both sides remain within the cosmic system, mapping the Father of Life's work onto natural craft. The chapter closes with Error and Darkness being cast into the Deep. Only one dialogue-frame attribution at i=2 (ⲡⲧⲁⲭⲉ ⲡϥⲱⲥⲧⲏⲣ) — extracted as mixed. No editorial seams detected.
